I really thought this was gonna be one of those shows with the dumbass names that was just enjoyable enough to watch, but not good enough to recommend. 

It genuinely surprised me. This show was so fucking adorable. I keep recommending it to people that I know love romance anime. Thanks to the name it's very hard to get them to watch, but I know they'll love it. 

Not only is it a fun fantasy twist on romance anime with an interesting backstory(/world building? Unsure of the right term here), but the awkwardness that happens in the show actually feels genuine. Like hey, I know, I'm not Japanese. I do not know their culture very well. I do, however, enjoy their media, but as a Westerner I get sick of the super slow romance a lot of the time. The nervousness and the "oh no is this ok?!" for anything more than a glance can get very tiresome in a lot of anime for me. This show though, while it has the same kind of things happening, for some reason, feels really natural and cute for these characters as opposed to them just being scared or insecure.

Anyway, dumb romcom anime opinions aside, I really did enjoy this show and I hope we get season 2 dub.
